decisions.title: Model objective
decisions.question: Confirm the deterministic NYCH encoder plus tiny decoder-only causal LM predicting the next NYCH token/symbol sequence?
decisions.recommended: Deterministic NYCH encoder plus tiny decoder-only causal LM; symbolic assurance kept distinct from probabilistic output.

decisions.title: Context window
decisions.question: Approve tokens per window (longer accepted input split into ordered windows, never truncated)?

decisions.title: Domain lexicon seed and thresholds
decisions.question: Which seed lexicon and confidence/tie threshold should B4 use?
decisions.recommended: Owner-supplied versioned local associative lexicon; thresholds to be specified; UNKNOWN when uncertain.

decisions.title: GST context assembly and lookup
decisions.question: B5 GST v2 and additive TOTE migration 002 (historical approval).
decisions.recommended: Additive TOTE SQLite v2; user_version=2; exact domain_id + action_key lookup; ambiguity is cache miss; versioned GST JSON; unknown origins fail closed.

decisions.title: Symbol-selection call contract
decisions.question: Approve exact request/response JSON for GST + separate prompt, literal fallback, no automatic TOTE write-back?
decisions.recommended: GST and prompt as separate inputs; literal fallback; no TOTE write-back until write/admission contract approved.

decisions.title: Embedding width (d_model)
decisions.question: Approve d_model (learned embeddings, RoPE, float32 reference)?

decisions.title: Attention heads
decisions.question: Approve heads (two causal layers, head width 32, no KV cache)?

decisions.title: SwiGLU hidden width
decisions.question: Approve Pre-RMSNorm block with SwiGLU width (dropout 0.1 training only)?

decisions.title: Output head
decisions.question: Approve tied embeddings, full-vocabulary logits, stable softmax, next-token cross-entropy?
decisions.recommended: Tied embeddings, full-vocabulary logits, stable softmax, next-token cross-entropy.

decisions.title: Neural corpus and training
decisions.question: Select license-cleared English corpus distinct from typo-statistics corpus?
decisions.recommended: Owner-approved license-cleared corpus; dedup; fixed split; no prompts; recorded seeds/config/hardware; baseline on same split.

decisions.title: Inspector evidence bar
decisions.question: Approve contract coverage, negative/boundary/adversarial tests, reproducibility, exact digests; missing evidence blocks PASS?
decisions.recommended: Separate Inspector per Builder; missing evidence means INTERMEDIATE.

decisions.title: GitSON contract/runtime
decisions.question: Approve per-boundary GitSON with digests, upstream PASS, trusted host validation, <500,000-byte cap?
decisions.recommended: Interface-versioned per-boundary GitSON; exact artifact and upstream PASS digests; trusted host validation; <500,000 bytes.

decisions.title: Tiny-model size and resource budget
decisions.question: Choose parameter band, memory/latency target, training hardware.
decisions.recommended: OWNER INPUT REQUIRED: no numeric size is assumed.

decisions.title: Benchmark and success criteria
decisions.question: Choose structural fidelity, semantic preservation, OOV/typo, next-token, latency, baseline measures.
decisions.recommended: Report each measure separately against a standard baseline; thresholds owner-set.

decisions.title: Packaging/release target
decisions.question: Choose downloadable format and supported runtime/device.
decisions.recommended: Private until an explicit release decision; format owner-set.
